title: cyperus cataphyllatus
intro: Cyperus cataphyllatus, commonly known as umbrella plant or umbrella sedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Cyperus cataphyllatus include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and fighting infections. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral effects.
